pages.text: Dark clouds gathered. Sacks of olives still stood outside in the yard.
Lulu jumped up. "Let us bring all the sacks in before it rains!"
Aunt Rosa ran out first. "Hurry, hurry! Oh, trouble!"
She hugged a sack and ran this way and that. "Where? Barn? Kitchen?"
She came straight back out of the barn. "The kitchen is better!" Not one sack was safely inside.
Thunder rumbled. The sacks still lined the yard.
Aunt Rosa circled empty-handed. "So busy, so busy!"
Lulu lined up the cousins. "From yard to barn, hand to hand!"
Sacks passed along steadily. The last went into the barn just as raindrops pattered down.
Everyone watched the rain from the barn door. Aunt Rosa straightened her shoulders. "See? I told you to hurry!"
